value.rationale: DFS is an actual FFT-based spherical approximation transform. Its exact-degree, azimuthally resolved L2 distortion separates polar-concentrated and equator-concentrated harmonics with a sharp elliptic spectrum and two distinct quantitative asymptotic scales, supplying directly motivated operator conditioning information absent from general regularity statements.
